notes: Distinguished the speaker’s manifesto programme from an implemented national government. Pan-African migration and LGBTQ consultation qualify racial-national and social-conservative shortcuts. The 2014 Christian statement supports a qualified period-continuity identity inference; it does not imply religious law. Land question 15 literally includes compensation, unlike his uncompensated land programme. Checked all 240 literal statements and agreement directions, the 15 independent axis briefs, counter-evidence, source references, period, metadata and inferred uncertainty. All 240 responses remain conservatively marked inferred; exact IDs are in the separate review. Technical validation cannot certify the historical or political estimates. Similarity decisions are added only after checking calculated neighbours.

Counter-evidence and limits: His defence of controversial liberation songs suggests resistance to expansive speech prohibitions; that is not a defence of all racial hatred. Anti-racism and opposition to bans on struggle songs pull in different directions. The specified mechanism combines competing aims in this record; a mixed response is chosen for that substantive conflict, not merely because exact evidence is unavailable.
